title: Stiff curtains, slightly damaged not due to transit
text:
Stiff curtains, slightly damaged not due to transit. The curtains are a nice bright white. Stiff looking…too much starch look. Found a pulling of the threads, that created a hole in the crease of the curtains. I wouldn’t have notice except the sunlight picked it up.

They are as pictured otherwise.
